_about: Baseline content that is deliberately not on the site any more, each with its reason. tools/ux-ledger.js fails on anything missing that is not listed here. Only interface labels belong in this file: substantive content must stay reachable.

blocks.ExplorerCompassBy backgroundBy fieldAll: Interface labels. The Career Explorer's old local navigation row, replaced by the shared section navigation (Explore careers: Overview, Career Compass, By what you studied, By field, All roles, Compare roles, Italian pay, Research sources) and, for Calendar, Toolkit and Interview prep, by the Find an internship or job section navigation. Every destination is still linked from every page.
blocks.Admetia — an independent calculator for: Interface label. The 404 page's footer line, reworded with the site's motto now that the site covers careers, hiring and moving as well as the calculators.
blocks.Programmes: Interface label. The 404 page's link to programmes.html, now labelled Programme Directory like every other link to that page.
blocks.Atlas: Interface label. The 404 page's link to map.html, now labelled Plan a move like the global navigation.
blocks.Compass: Interface label. The breadcrumb on careers/compass.html, now Career Compass, the page's own title.
blocks.Italy pay: Interface label. The breadcrumb on careers/italy-pay.html, now Italian pay, as in the section navigation.
blocks.01: Decoration. The numeral beside the Business entry on the old front page (aria-hidden); the entry itself is on study.html.
blocks.02: Decoration. The numeral beside the IT & Computing entry on the old front page (aria-hidden); the entry itself is on study.html.
